title: An Evaluation of Estimative Uncertainty in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM probability estimates for Words of Estimative Probability (WEPs) using counterfactual narrative contexts that vary the subject's gender pronoun ('She' versus 'He').
Evaluating differences and divergences in numerical probability estimates for Words of Estimative Probability (WEPs) when models are prompted in English versus Chinese.
